quick_english: In this scripture composed by the Supreme Lord under the name Jñānacandra, I have explained this clear yet profound statement, following the method of establishing the authority of our own tradition and also through various relevant contexts. quick_english: Those who inquire properly are truly auspicious, so what effort is needed toward them? As for those people barren of scripture, their vehemence is like the ocean at cosmic dissolution; therefore this agitation only whirls back within oneself.
